extracted.intended_audience: patent searchers, researchers, librarians, IPO members, and anyone using The Lens for patent analysis
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for searching, filtering, organizing, analyzing, and exporting patent and related scholarly data using The Lens platform, including structured search syntax, result refinement, workspace features, and privacy best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field selection for searches
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lens allows you to select fields to be searched. They include: Lens Id, Pub Key, Kind, Pub Num, Pub Year, Title, Abstract, Inventor, Owner, Full Text, Claims, Classification Ipcr, Classification Nat, Classification Cpc, Cites Patent Pub Key, Cites Patent Count.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose appropriate searchable fields to focus results (e.g., Title, Abstract, Claims, Full Text). Note that an assignee field is not present; use the “Applicants” field selection for similar results. The “Owners” field is specifically US assignment data used to supplement EPO‑derived Applicant as published data. The Lens provides links to global patent status information using OPS of the EPO as default.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boolean / structured search syntax
rubrics_metrics.description: Structured searches are possible using Boolean operators (examples: portable AND solar AND usb AND charger; portable AND solar AND (usb OR "universal serial bus") AND charger).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operators AND, OR and NOT must be in all caps. Use the Edit Search feature to open the Structured Search and the Query Text Editor for complex queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document type filtering
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lens organizes its collection by nine different document types: Patent Application, Granted Patent, Limited Patent, Search report, Amended Patent, Design Right, Abstract, Amended Patent, and Plant Patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter or restrict searches by document type to target the desired publication stage or IP right. (Note: 'Amended Patent' is listed twice in the source; interpret as a single document type option in filtering.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Persistent record identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Lens ID is a 15 digit identifier for each patent record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Lens ID (and other persistent identifiers) to unambiguously reference and share specific records; useful when creating collections or exporting data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Work Area to save and organize search work
rubrics_metrics.description: Work Area features include Search History, Saved Queries, Collections, Notes, Tags, Inventorship, Sequence Bulk Download and Analysis Dashboards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign in to consistently save queries, collections, documents, and notes across computers; receive alerts on searches; create collections to organize data; and save customized analysis dashboards for reuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create, annotate, share and export collections and portfolios
rubrics_metrics.description: Create, annotate and share collections of patent and scholarship portfolios. Options exist to create, add, remove or make a note to add information to a document and to export and publish collections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select records (checkbox or top 'All Results'/'Page Results') to create collections. Use sharing/access settings when collaborating, and export collections for reports or downstream analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filters / facets and include/exclude functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: Sidebar filters provide numerous options to refine the search; facets/graphs include Date Range, Jurisdictions, Inventors, Owners (US), Applicants, Cited Works, Document Families, Classifications, Document Type, Biologicals, Collections, Query tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use down arrows to view filter options and include or exclude values. The platform allows you to 'ignore' or include/exclude various parameters within your result set to refine analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection and bulk operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Click the check box for a record or at the top to select All Results or Page Results to open the option to create a collection of documents of interest for later review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use bulk selection to add many records to collections, create exports, or run batch analyses rather than handling items one-by-one.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refine, edit, and re-run searches
rubrics_metrics.description: Refine the search by changing search terms and clicking on 'Refine search'. The down arrow next to 'Refine Search' provides rapid access to a New Search or the Classification Viewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Iteratively refine queries, use the Classification Viewer to explore classification codes, and use Edit Search/Query Text Editor for structured adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sorting and result ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: Sort options include: rank, publication, filing, priority, cited, sequences or family.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose sort order appropriate to the task (e.g., sort by cited to find influential patents, by filing/priority to find earliest families).

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis Preview and full analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Search results include an Analysis Preview column and a Full analysis tab for deeper charts and graphs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the preview for quick insights and open the Full analysis tab for more detailed visualizations. The Analysis tools support drilling into facets like jurisdictions, applicants, years, classifications, and families.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation exploration (Cited by / Cites / PatCite)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tabs show Cited by and Cites for forward and backward citations; PatCite explores cited works/citing patents and their linkages. The cited works tab shows links to article sources and OpenURL links to WorldCat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use citation links to track influence and prior art; follow OpenURL/WorldCat links to locate full‑text scholarly works. Cited by Works shows patents citing NPL and group families when grouping is ON.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent document view and metadata export
rubrics_metrics.description: Document view tabs include summary & full text, family and legal information, notes, collection options, make a note, and document preview. Download citation options include RIS, BibTeX, CSV or JSON. You can download PDF and open scanned document previews; key search terms are highlighted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reviewing a record, examine summary, full text, claims, and family/legal information. Use notes and collection annotations to record findings; export bibliographic metadata in the format your workflow requires.

rubrics_metrics.name: PatSeq: access to biological sequence disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: PatSeq enables access to patents disclosing genetic sequences and bulk downloads of disclosed sequence data based on jurisdiction, document type, and either sequence type or sequence location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PatSeq to find sequence-containing patents and to perform sequence bulk downloads (sequence bulk download enables downloading more than 300M sequence listings in FASTA format for downstream bioinformatic analysis).

rubrics_metrics.name: Visualization and chart options
rubrics_metrics.description: Chart options include document type, chart type (pie chart or bar chart), applicants display and number options, publications by year with click-and-drag to select a time period, and inventor display and number options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customize charts to visualize distributions (by year, applicant, document type, inventor). Save chart configurations in Analysis Dashboards for repeated reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and security best practices for patent searching
rubrics_metrics.description: IPO Search Committee suggested best practices: 1) Only search on encrypted (HTTPS) sites; 2) Delete your browser history after you have finished, or search in an 'incognito window'; 3) Store your search notes on your computer’s encrypted hard drive, or in the Cloud.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Lens is an https secure site and states it does not sell data, but follow the IPO recommendations to protect search confidentiality and sensitive client or project details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use help resources and knowledge database
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lens provides Help Resources (video tutorials, basic help, search results, result views, document views, advanced document views, workspaces, biological tools, patent sequence tools) and a Knowledge Database covering basics, claims, continuity, patent rights, around the world, biological and developer resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these resources to learn platform features, advanced search techniques, interpretation of patent concepts, and developer APIs for custom workflows.
